script_text: The stars are about to force Taurus into the most transformative romantic crossroads of the year. Monday ignites as Mars charges into your 1st House, fueling your earthy ambition — yet Mercury's square to Saturn in your 8th House on Tuesday creates tense friction around shared finances and career partnerships. Wednesday cautions against impulsive investment decisions. Thursday shifts everything when Venus, your ruling planet, enters your 5th House from Libra, launching a powerful season of love and creative expression. Through the weekend, Venus forms a trine to Jupiter in your 8th House, deepening romance and joint financial opportunities. Your fixed earth nature keeps you grounded through these expansive shifts. Thursday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House. Tuesday is your worst day because Mercury squares Saturn in your 8th House. Taurus thrives by investing in love and creative growth, not speculation. Follow for daily updates.
